args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

Gideon, here's a draft from #inc-vtg-hartford. All times are Aug 3, 2026.

**Hartford gate kiosk incident summary**

- **First report, 10:42 AM:** Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan, so gate kiosks were offline. The guard logged trailers on paper in the meantime.
- **Kiosk 1 back, 11:03 AM:** Mateo confirmed the kiosk was working again. The guard checked in trailer 8836, and dispatch could see it.
- **Both lanes confirmed working, 11:07 AM:** Gideon posted the confirmation at 11:08 AM, giving 11:07 as the time both lanes worked.
- **Scope:** Scheduling stayed up throughout, because the dispatch office was unaffected. The problem was gate check-in only.
- **Open item:** Mateo's account can't open the status page. This is tracked separately under INC-4821. His admin account can still open Pemberline Dock.

I haven't sent anything. Mateo is outside pemberline.com, so any email to him, even as a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval. You could paste this into the incident channel instead, where he's already a member.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosk incident summary (all times Aug 3, 2026)
- First report, 10:42 AM: Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan, so gate kiosks were offline. The guard logged trailers on paper in the meantime.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) checked the Hartford gateway route.
- Kiosk 1 back, 11:03 AM: Mateo confirmed the kiosk was working again. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working, 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM).
- Scope: Scheduling stayed up throughout. The problem was gate check-in only.
- Open item: Mateo's account can't open the status page. This is tracked in INC-4821. His admin account can still open Pemberline Dock.
